visual_strategy: Precision meets regulatory authority. Clean, functional aesthetic that communicates trust and technical competence without visual noise.

primary.psychology: Validation, go-signal, correctness. Triggers confidence and action. Used sparingly for maximum impact on CTAs and status indicators.

secondary.psychology: Authority, permanence, seriousness. Anchors the brand in regulatory gravitas without being cold.

accent.psychology: Clarity, space to think, professionalism. Creates breathing room in dense regulatory interfaces.

typography.header: Geist Sans Light/SemiBold — clean, technical, modern. Conveys precision without decoration.
typography.body: Geist Sans Regular/Medium — highly readable, neutral, gets out of the way of content.
typography.data: Geist Mono Regular/Medium — monospace for document fields, validation reports, audit trails. Signals technical accuracy.

logo_guidelines.placement: Top-left or centered. Always on white or light stone background.
logo_guidelines.clear_space: Minimum 1x icon height on all sides
logo_guidelines.constraints: Never distort, never add effects, never place on busy backgrounds

imagery_art_direction.photography: Documentary precision. Real regulatory documents, real desks, real processes. No stock-photo humans.
imagery_art_direction.illustration: Technical diagrams with Swiss precision. Clean lines, minimal color, information-first.
imagery_art_direction.environments: Modern office, regulatory desk, clean workspace. Neutral tones with green accent lighting.

graphic_elements.shapes: Sharp corners, precise angles, grid-aligned. No rounded corners on data elements.
graphic_elements.textures: Fine-grain stone paper, brushed aluminum, circuit traces — subtle, never dominant.
graphic_elements.patterns: Grid systems, document flow diagrams, validation checkmark motifs
